temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan initially says Christian can trust him, but then admits Christian is right: he has been keeping something from him and is in trouble; he didn't know how to tell him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: the suspicion is confirmed; Jonathan admits he has been hiding something and is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding something important from him and is in trouble; the exact nature of the trouble is still unknown.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious before; worried, concerned, and somewhat validated after.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To learn more about Jonathan's trouble and decide how to respond to the disclosure.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he does not want to drag Christian into it, but he accepts Christian's offer and admits he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan has been hiding something important from him and is in trouble; the exact nature of the trouble is still unknown.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jonathan is willing to accept help and has a concrete need for support/resources; the trouble is complicated.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in complicated trouble and needs Christian's support and resources to get out of it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Jonathan, offer support and resources, and face the trouble together.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot say for sure, that he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but that he did not do anything illegal himself; Jonathan trusts Christian to investigate carefully.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble may be related to some kind of criminal activity; Christian feels conflicted and concerned.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Partially confirmed and refined: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong/dangerous people, but he denies personally doing anything illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan's trouble likely involves wrong or criminal people, though Jonathan claims he himself did nothing illegal; the truth needs discreet investigation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan and to ensure Jonathan's safety.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed and that someone is trying to set him up; Jonathan is surprised and grateful for Christian's help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble likely involves wrong or criminal people, though Jonathan claims he himself did nothing illegal; the truth needs discreet investigation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian moves from suspecting involvement with wrong people to believing Jonathan is an innocent victim of a frame-up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by someone, and Christian needs to prove Jonathan's innocence.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear Jonathan's name and gather more evidence to prove his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian tells Jonathan that he has found out who is behind the frame-up: someone both of them know and trust. Jonathan warns Christian to be careful because the person is dangerous but says he trusts him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by someone, and Christian needs to prove Jonathan's innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: the unknown framer is identified as a trusted person close to both Christian and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The real culprit is someone close to and trusted by both Christian and Jonathan, and that person is framing Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice so the betrayal does not go unpunished.
